articles.title: India, Sri Lanka connected by deep civilisational, spiritual bonds: PM Modi on relics exposition
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi emphasized India and Sri Lanka's deep civilisational and spiritual bonds during talks with Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake. Modi thanked Dissanayake for an inauguration, highlighting strengthened bilateral ties. This interaction underscores ongoing efforts to enhance cooperation and mutual understanding between the two South Asian nations, crucial for regional stability and mutual growth.
